info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Support Tickets Closes-v1-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Closure API enables users to retrieve a list of support tickets that have been closed. This endpoint primarily serves customer support teams looking to monitor resolved issues, ensuring efficient resolution tracking and enhancing service quality. Typical consumers include support agents and managers seeking insights into closed tickets for reporting or performance assessments. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline their support processes and improve customer satisfaction through timely follow-ups.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to close an existing support ticket in the system. Once a ticket is closed, it cannot be reopened, ensuring that all resolved issues are officially marked as completed.

requestBody.description: Request body for closing a ticket, providing the necessary data for processing the closure operation.

200.description: The request was successful, and the ticket has been closed.

ListSupportTicketsClosesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for closing a ticket operation in JSON format.

ListSupportTicketsClosesResponse_200.title: Close Ticket Response

status.description: Indicates if the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the request.

resultId.description: The result identifier of the closed ticket.

state.description: The current state of the ticket.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Details about the audit trail of the operation.

ListSupportTicketsClosesResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response returned from closing a ticket operation.

Audit.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the ticket.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the ticket was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the ticket closure was automated.

Audit.description: Schema representing audit details for the operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. A value of 0 indicates that the request was processed instantly.
